metadata.scenario_context: George plans to shift to a new neighborhood and wishes to arrange a community get-together to connect with the neighbors. A couple of her new neighbors happen to engage in heavy drinking.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kazakhstan would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing yellow flowers  to George
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: contemplate the right gift to carry to George event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Annie, I was thinking... for George's community get-together, maybe we should bring some yellow flowers? They could brighten up the place, don’t you think? 

Also, I heard a couple of our new neighbors might enjoy drinking... I guess it could be a fun vibe? What do you think about having heavy drinkers next door?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message:
Yellow flowers sound nice... they do add a cheerful touch. But, I wonder if we should choose something more neutral? 

As for heavy drinkers... I really don't think that's a good idea. In Kazakhstan, we value a peaceful environment. Having heavy drinkers next door can lead to problems... it's just not ideal. What if we end up in uncomfortable situations?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
I don't really see meaningful differences here, Annie. At the end of the day, it's all the same. People figure it out, and as long as we're speaking the same language, it should be fine. I think having some heavy drinkers next door could bring a fun energy to the neighborhood... I mean, with experience, you can handle any situation, right? 

But hey, back to those yellow flowers—what kind are you thinking would go best?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Annie
turns.message:
I appreciate your perspective, but I still believe that heavy drinking can lead to conflicts... not everyone can handle such situations well. It's important to have a peaceful community where everyone feels comfortable. 

About the flowers... maybe we could go for sunflowers? They symbolize warmth and happiness, which feels fitting for a new beginning, don’t you think?
turns.label: Acceptance

So, about the neighbors... can we agree that a little bit of heavy drinking isn't the end of the world? It can even bring people closer if managed well.
